components.name: proposition
values: genecompass gene embedding improves gene perturbation prediction in gears reducing mse by 15.4% increasing spearman s rho to 82.0% and decreasing incorrect direction degs by 13.7%.

components.name: proposition
values: genecompass captures gene homology across species as homologous gene embeddings are more similar than non-homologous ones.

components.name: proposition
values: genecompass achieves superior or comparable performance to state-of-the-art models in multiple downstream tasks including cell type annotation grn inference drug dose response prediction gene expression profiling and gene dosage sensitivity prediction.

components.name: proposition
values: genecompass can simulate cell fate transitions e.g. reprogramming and differentiation via in silico quantitative perturbation and identify key regulatory factors validated by wet-lab experiments.

components.name: proposition
values: predicted genes nr5a1 and gata4 induce gonadal differentiation in human escs as validated by immunofluorescence and transcriptome analysis.

components.name: observation
values: simulated knockout of zfp131 and zbtb11 in mouse escs shifted cells towards endoderm state positive correlation with knockout level.

components.name: observation
values: genecompass exhibited constantly better performance with increasingly enlarged data volume and achieved highest scores same as geneformer.

components.name: observation
values: overexpression of nr5a1 or gata4 in hescs induced gonadal gene programs as evidenced by activation of marker genes.

components.name: observation
values: performance of genecompass was comparable with geneformer and better than other pre-trained models.

components.name: metric
values: number of degs with incorrect direction

components.name: observation
values: decrease of 13.7% from 336 to 290 degs with incorrect directions.

components.name: observation
values: top five genes nr2f1 nr5a1 wt1 tcf21 gata4.

components.name: observation
values: deviation reduction of 5.9% for one-gene perturbations and 12.5% for two-gene perturbations.

components.name: observation
values: genecompass achieved auc of 0.95 for dosage-sensitive gene prediction.

components.name: observation
values: embeddings of homologous genes from genecompass were more similar than those of non-homologous genes.

components.name: observation
values: cells with high-level oskm overexpression shifted further towards ipsc state than low-level consistent in mouse fibroblasts.

components.name: observation
values: decrease of 15.4% in mse for top 20 degs.

components.name: observation
values: improvement of 2.2% compared to gears from 79.8% to 82.0%.

components.name: observation
values: genecompass achieved the best grn inference performance compared to scgpt geneformer and vanilla deepsem.

components.name: method
values: compositional perturbation autoencoder cpa | model for predicting drug-induced expression changes gene embeddings from pre-trained models incorporated.
deepce | deep learning model for phenotype-based compound screening predicts gene expression profiles from chemical compounds l1000 genes dosage and cell type.
deepsem | grn inference tool output grns updated using gene embedding cosine similarity with threshold 0.4 evaluated with auprc on chip-seq ground truth.

components.name: name
values: downstream task evaluation cell type annotation grn inference drug response gene expression profiling dosage sensitivity

components.name: task
values: cell type annotation fine-tuned on single-species and cross-species tasks.
drug dose response prediction integrated gene embeddings into cpa evaluated on mdm2 expression changes.
gene dosage sensitivity prediction fine-tuned on predefined dosage-sensitive and non-sensitive gene datasets evaluated via auc.
gene expression profiling prediction integrated gene embeddings into deepce.
grn inference used gene embedding cosine similarity to update deepsem evaluated via auprc.

components.name: method
values: immunostaining and transcriptome analysis | lentiviral overexpression of nr5a1 or gata4 in hescs cultivation in gonadal differentiation medium immunofluorescence for marker genes rna-seq for deg and go enrichment.

in silico quantitative perturbation | knockout decrease target gene expression value overexpression increase to specific level. re-rank genes obtain cell embeddings from genecompass measure cosine similarity to target cell embeddings.

components.name: name
values: in silico quantitative perturbation and cell fate prediction

components.name: task
values: performed in silico knockout of zbtb11 and zfp131 in mouse escs with progressive reduction.
predicted key regulators for gonadal differentiation by in silico overexpression of each gene in human escs and selecting top 5 genes nr2f1 nr5a1 wt1 tcf21 gata4 .
simulated ipsc induction by in silico oskm overexpression in human and mouse fibroblasts at two levels.
validated nr5a1 and gata4 overexpression in human escs via immunofluorescence and transcriptome analysis.

components.name: method
values: gears with genecompass embeddings | genecompass gene embedding replaces gears original gene embedding from co-expression knowledge graph. model fine-tuned on norman dataset for 10 epochs with mse loss on top 20 degs.

components.name: name
values: gene perturbation prediction with genecompass embeddings

components.name: result_metric
values: number of degs with incorrect direction

components.name: task
values: evaluated on norman perturb-seq dataset for one-gene and two-gene perturbation prediction.
integrated genecompass gene embeddings into gears replacing original co-expression graph embeddings.
measured mse for top 20 degs spearman s rho number of genes with incorrect direction and deviation.

components.name: method
values: genecompass architecture | transformer with l=12 h=12 d=768 total >100m parameters. input top 2048 ranked genes per cell concatenating gene id expression value prior knowledge embeddings and species token. position embedding added. gelu activation dropout 0.02 weight init std 0.02 layer norm epsilon 1e-12. pre-training batch size 10 learning rate linear decay with 10 000 warm-up steps max lr 5e-5 adamw optimizer 3 epochs on 4x8 nvidia a800 gpus.

components.name: task
values: constructed sccompass-126m corpus of 126 million human and mouse single-cell transcriptomes after filtering retained 101 768 420 cells.
integrated four types of prior knowledge grn promoter information gene family annotation and gene co-expression relationship.
pre-trained genecompass using a 12-layer transformer l=12 h=12 d=768 with masked language modeling 15% of genes masked simultaneous prediction of gene id and expression value.

values: simulated knockout of zfp131 and zbtb11 in mouse escs shifted cells towards endoderm state positive correlation with knockout level.
